sqlMap.select: SELECT I.INVENTORY_ID, I.PRODUCT_ID, I.WAREHOUSE_ID, I.QUANTITY, P.PRODUCT_NAME, W.WAREHOUSE_NAME FROM INVENTORY I INNER JOIN PRODUCTS P ON I.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID INNER JOIN WAREHOUSES W ON I.WAREHOUSE_ID = W.WAREHOUSE_ID WHERE I.PRODUCT_ID = #productId#
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(QUANTITY), 0) FROM INVENTORY WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #productId#

SELECT I.INVENTORY_ID, I.PRODUCT_ID, I.WAREHOUSE_ID, I.QUANTITY, P.PRODUCT_NAME, W.WAREHOUSE_NAME FROM INVENTORY I INNER JOIN PRODUCTS P ON I.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID INNER JOIN WAREHOUSES W ON I.WAREHOUSE_ID = W.WAREHOUSE_ID WHERE I.QUANTITY <= #threshold#
I.WAREHOUSE_ID = #warehouseId#
ORDER BY I.QUANTITY ASC

#productIds[]#
